proposal_identity_definition: sha256(canonical_json_utf8(proposal with proposal_identity_hash, manifest_hash, and human_authorization_text omitted))
hash_command: PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -c 'import hashlib,json; from agentctl.hashing import canonical_json; from pathlib import Path; p=json.loads(Path("agent-system/work/P0/proposals/local-authentication-bootstrap-policy.json").read_text()); [p.pop(k) for k in ("proposal_identity_hash","manifest_hash","human_authorization_text")]; print(hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(p).encode()).hexdigest())'

operations.exact_change: No policy bytes change. The existing approve_command.requires_key_unlock_passphrase=true is explicitly method-scoped: require the passphrase only when the selected method is interactive_tty_with_key_unlock; after successful local_authentication, permit runtime external-key access without a raw seal-key prompt.
Permit the currently configured human principal to use local_authentication in addition to interactive_tty_with_key_unlock; no role, scope, grant, fingerprint, or principal identity changes.

protected_base_assertions.assertion: No active approval-policy bytes change. In particular, approve_command.requires_key_unlock_passphrase remains true and all action tiers remain unchanged.
No active approval schema bytes change; local_authentication remains the existing schema method.

required_implementation_followup.scope: approval command/library and focused tests only
requirements: Select only a method permitted by the requested action tier and the principal allow-list.

Do not alter action tiers, risk tiers, principal role/scope/grants, fingerprints, seal/MAC/expiry/single-use controls, or governance schema payload.
Add focused tests for conditional key-unlock behavior, principal-method enforcement, and fail-closed ordering.
